races.title: Dane Architectural Systems Millionaire EBF 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: NIKOLAVS OTTO caught the eye in a Perth maiden that has worked out very well and could be the value play up against Willie Mullins' Leader Allen , who's likely to be a warm order. NIKOLAVS OTTO (IRE) LEADER ALLEN (FR) MEASURE OF A MAN (IRE)

races.title: J&D Pierce Steeling The Race Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: RED DELTA shaped well when fourth behind Passengerontheship at Sedgefield (boosted form since) on his return and showed his liking for this track when an excellent third in last season's Eider Chase so gets the vote on these revised terms. The latter named rates a big threat though in his hat-trick bid, while Impatient and I Wish You can also play a prominent role in this intriguing handicap. RED DELTA PASSENGERONTHESHIP (IRE) IMPATIENT (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Impatient (11/8), Passengerontheship (9/4), I Wish You (11/2), Ki Woo (15/2), Red Delta (8/1), Pinot Rouge (66/1)

races.title: Weatherbys And Birdie Calendars 'The French Furze' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A tough call to split OLD COAST ROAD and Splendid Fellow on these terms. Dan Skelton's unbeaten hurdler perhaps has the greater potential and is narrowly preferred to the Irish standard-setter. OLD COAST ROAD (IRE) SPLENDID FELLOW (IRE) LAUVERGNAT (FR)

races.title: SES Engineering Powering Past The Rehearsal Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Anthony Honeyball holds a solid hand here with JORDANS CROSS and Crest of Fortune , the former taken to get back on track with the form of his Cheltenham win at the start of the year proving strong. Venetia Williams has a good record in this, so Alcedo is another to consider having won at this meeting 12 months ago. JORDANS CROSS (IRE) CREST OF FORTUNE ALCEDO (IRE)

races.title: Bowmer And Kirkland We Build As One Fighting Fifth Hurdle (Grade 1) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A good opportunity for ALEXEI to land a breakthrough Grade 1 success. Last year's winner of this race Golden Ace was held by Joe Tizzard's charge during the spring, and it could be improving Mydaddypaddy that gives the selection most to think about. ALEXEI (GER) MYDADDYPADDY (IRE) GOLDEN ACE
races.bettingForecast: Alexei (6/5), Mydaddypaddy (6/4), Golden Ace (11/2), Minella Study (16/1), Nemean Lion (25/1), Indemnity (66/1)

races.title: Ryder & Cundall Designed To Go The Distance Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: CAVE BRIDGE made an encouraging handicap debut after 12 months off when sixth in a big field at Newbury and could be the answer with this longer trip expected to suit. The Kalooki Kid was rather unlucky to bump into one back in this sphere at Wetherby so rates the main threat ahead of the progressive Las Canals . CAVE BRIDGE (IRE) THE KALOOKI KID LAS CANALS (FR)

races.title: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Progressive ALBIE LITTLEWOOD is fancied to bring up the 4-timer for the Skeltons. Looking Splendid and Diamond Mix both appeal as solid dangers, while class-dropper Genois needs a close look in the betting. ALBIE LITTLEWOOD (IRE) LOOKING SPLENDID DIAMOND MIX (IRE)
